clauses.code: int count_valid_assignments(int n, int k, int m, int tests[][20], int outcomes[], int counts[]) { int valid = 0; for(int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) { int ok = 1; for(int i = 0; i < m && ok; i++) { int real_count = 0; for(int j = 0; j < counts[i]; j++) if(mask & (1 << (tests[i][j] - 1))) real_count++; ok = ((real_count >= k) == outcomes[i]); } if(ok) valid++; } return valid; }

clauses.code: int count_valid_assignments(int n, int k, int m, int tests[][20], int outcomes[], int counts[]) { int count = 0; for(int config = 0; config < (1 << n); config++) { int works = 1; for(int test_idx = 0; test_idx < m; test_idx++) { int num_real = 0; for(int key_idx = 0; key_idx < counts[test_idx]; key_idx++) { int key = tests[test_idx][key_idx] - 1; if(config & (1 << key)) num_real++; } int opened = (num_real >= k); if(opened != outcomes[test_idx]) { works = 0; break; } } count += works; } return count; }

clauses.code: int count_valid_assignments(int n, int k, int m, int tests[][20], int outcomes[], int counts[]) { int total = 0; for(int bitmask = 0; bitmask < (1 << n); bitmask++) { int consistent = 1; for(int i = 0; i < m; i++) { int real_keys = 0; for(int j = 0; j < counts[i]; j++) { int key_num = tests[i][j] - 1; if((bitmask >> key_num) & 1) real_keys++; } int should_open = (real_keys >= k); if(should_open != outcomes[i]) { consistent = 0; break; } } total += consistent; } return total; }

clauses.code: int count_valid_assignments(int n, int k, int m, int tests[][20], int outcomes[], int counts[]) { int possibilities = 0; for(int assignment = 0; assignment < (1 << n); assignment++) { int valid = 1; for(int test = 0; test < m; test++) { int real = 0; for(int idx = 0; idx < counts[test]; idx++) { if(assignment & (1 << (tests[test][idx] - 1))) real++; } if((real >= k) != outcomes[test]) { valid = 0; break; } } if(valid) possibilities++; } return possibilities; }
